sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Dawley Town on Saturday at 14:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent league defeat. Sandbach remain top of the table with 31 points from 14 games, though their form has wobbled slightly after a run of four consecutive wins; they'll be keen to reassert their dominance against a Dawley side sitting mid-table.
divisionWide: Several fixtures carry significant implications for the title race and promotion spots. Second-placed AFC Bridgnorth's title credentials remain on hold as they don't feature this weekend. Third-ranked Bilston Town are absent as well, leaving the door open for fourth-place Stafford Town (26 points) to make ground in their home clash against struggling Telford Town (7 points). Eccleshall, sitting fifth with 25 points, host Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, level on points with Eccleshall, travel to face Allscott Heath in a competitive encounter. Barnton (6th, 22 points) welcome Foley Meir, while Cheadle Heath Nomads face Brereton Social in a battle between sides occupying the middle-to-lower reaches of the division. New Mills host Wednesfield Community as both teams vie for improved positions. Market Drayton Town take on Crewe at home; both clubs are struggling and in need of wins. Bottom-half sides Widnes Town (6 points) and Alsager Town (7 points) face each other at The Marine Travel Arena in what amounts to a relegation six-pointer, with Widnes desperately seeking points after poor recent form.
